description: This file defines the ViewModel for managing the state of a notes list in an Android application. It includes state management for the list of notes, search query, and synchronization status, as well as methods for updating the query and triggering manual sync.

classes.name: NotesListViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing the UI state for a list of notes, including search query, notes list, and sync status. Provides functions to update search query and trigger manual synchronization.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the current search query, which filters the notes list.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Initiates a manual synchronization of notes, enqueueing a background task and attempting immediate sync.
